{{Quote|On the revised list of charges, now consisting of one charge, reckless endangerment of a population, how do you plead?''"<br />"''Guilty, your honor.|Mavari Zudan and Luke Skywalker, during the latter's trial|<ref name="Out" />}}
'''Mavari Zudan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Judge/Legends|judge]] on the [[Court of Justice]] in [[43 ABY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|In Alliance case why-oh-four-three-dash-seventeen thousand fourteen, ''The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker'', we have negotiated a conclusion, agreed to this day by the prosecution, the defense, and myself.|Zudan|<ref name="Out" />}}
Mavari Zudan was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Judge/Legends|judge]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Court of Justice]] in [[43 ABY]]. She was the judge during [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|trial]] in 43.5 ABY. During Skywalker's case she agreed to his terms for [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="Out" />

Later, she was the judge during the [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|trial]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], and ruled that he was not competent to stand trial, but that he would be encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], as he was too dangerous to be placed in a conventional [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Out" /> She [[44 ABY|later]] judged ex-Jedi Knight [[Tahiri Veila]]'s [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|trial]], and sentenced her to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Judge Zudan left word that you could leave the courtroom by her door and the back corridors if you'd like to avoid the press.|[[Galactic Alliance Security|Security]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]] to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Out" />}}
Despite the fact that she upheld the charges that [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] brought against Skywalker, Zudan seemed to be somewhat sympathetic to the Jedi cause. This would change later, however, as the courts ruled that Valin Horn was too dangerous to be put in a conventional prison; opting instead to contain him in carbonite.<ref name="Out" />
